collect.label: Collect execution evidence
collect.prompt: Collect real trace hashes, Git diff, child report and coverage checklist without substituting a model summary for raw evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence links the actual execution to the resulting files.

dispatch.label: Dispatch SubAgent
dispatch.prompt: The guarded executor must revalidate admission immediately before starting one real Codex implementer. Save execution only after successful process completion.
acceptance_criteria: A real child was started after revalidation and returned zero with a terminal turn completion.

prepare.label: Prepare task
prepare.prompt: Prepare the approved declared task using the guarded example executor. Save the actual brief-generation receipt, base SHA and Todo event as preparation.
acceptance_criteria: Receipt contains the observed nonempty brief hash, task id, expected base SHA and recorded in_progress event.

record.label: Record result
record.prompt: Record final success and completed Todo only after all completion checks have succeeded.
acceptance_criteria: Final status and observable Todo both agree with validated execution.

validate_completion.label: Validate completion
validate_completion.prompt: Check every declared coverage id and run the unchanged declared acceptance tests using the deterministic executor. Reject missing, duplicate or skipped coverage for complete success.
acceptance_criteria: The exact coverage set is DONE, fixed tests are unchanged and all pass.

validate_dispatch.label: Validate dispatch preconditions
validate_dispatch.prompt: Use the deterministic executor to inspect the prepared files and actual Git HEAD. Save admission only when every dispatch check passes.
acceptance_criteria: All actual prerequisites pass; absent evidence must fail the attempt.
